meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把关分析检测方法是否经得起验证审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要给实验室检测方法准备验证和证明材料。
copy.tagline_en: Prove your lab method is reliable for its intended use before release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must show an analytical method is fit for its intended purpose under regulations.

howto.what: 按所选框架（ICH Q2(R2)、ICH M10、USP 等）规划分析方法验证与转移。Claude 会用内置脚本生成协议草稿，核对线性、检出限、精密度等统计量，并输出方案与逐项结果；只报告发现，不自行判定“已验证”。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计分析验证/转移、评估线性/重复性/检出限等参数，或提到“方法验证”“ICH Q2”“ICH M10”等关键词时。只要问题是某个分析流程是否适合其用途，就会接管。

say.text: 按 ICH Q2(R2) 为含量测定方法拟定验证方案。
检查这份标曲的线性是否符合要求。
按 ICH M10 核对色谱法这批 QC 是否合格。

howto.what_en: Plans analytical method validation or transfer under a chosen framework (ICH Q2(R2), ICH M10, USP etc.). Claude uses bundled scripts to draft protocols and compute linearity, detection limits, precision and related statistics, reporting findings without concluding that the method is validated.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to design or evaluate an analytical validation/transfer, mentions terms such as "method validation", "ICH Q2", "ICH M10", or asks whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose.

say_en.text: Draft a validation protocol for an HPLC assay under ICH Q2(R2).
say_en.note: Runs plan_validation.py and outputs a protocol.md with blanks to fill.

say_en.text: Check whether this calibration curve is linear.
say_en.note: Calls check_response.py with lack-of-fit and back-calculation error.

say_en.text: Check this chromatographic QC batch against ICH M10.
say_en.note: Runs check_bioanalytical_run.py and reports per-level QC findings.
